entries.title: Step-by-step guides for all 37 quests
items: Every quest on the Quests page has a "Step-by-step guide" button now. Each guide shows where to start and how to walk there, every item and monster you need with where it drops, every step in order, and every reward.
Tick steps off as you go. Your ticks stay on your device, and finishing the last step marks the quest done on the Quests page too.

We checked every quest against the Classic game data. Some quest cards got fixes: missing rewards added (Oranges for Dr. Betty, the headband for Mrs. Ming Ming, fame for Proof of Companionship), class boots and ingots for Nella's later requests, and corrected numbers for the Forgotten Hollow quests.

entries.title: Search that understands you, and tap-to-explain
items: Search now gets plain questions like "where to train 35" or "what class should I play", knows player slang (archer, sin, F/P, 2nd job), finds 124 items (with this week's price and drops where we have them), and searches every word on every page.
Every search result has a one-line "what is this" under it, like the town, the monsters and who it's best for.
Tap any dotted word (AP, KPQ, mesos, UTC...) or a Confirmed / Likely tag to see what it means. Works on phones now, not just with a mouse.
Your run: shows the minimap of your grind spot, says the monster level clearly, and spots that aren't open yet (Forgotten Hollow) wait until Nov 18.
The phone tab bar has Events in it now. Secrets moved to More.

entries.title: Price check, money farms and walking directions
items: New Price check page: search any item, see this week's price for 41 of them, then jump to NiaMeowDB, MesoWatch or HubCW for the live number. One tap copies the item name so you can paste it in.
This week's money farms: the four mobs worth hunting right now, what they drop and what it sells for.
Leveling: type your level and we'll show you where to go. Every training spot now has map-by-map directions from the nearest town, with a minimap link.
Bosses and hidden maps: how to walk to each one from town.
Rewrote the leveling tips so they read like a friend telling you where to go, not a spreadsheet.
Halloween prep: Malady hands out the candy quest in Henesys and Kerning City, and the Orange Slimes invade Henesys, Ellinia, Kerning City and Perion. The candy guide on Events has the details.

entries.title: Magicians, a 1-30 route and faster job advancement
items: Builds: a "Which Magician?" comparison of F/P, I/L and Cleric, on the Builds page and every Magician build.
Cleric: a new "How to level a Cleric" section (undead maps, the Heal change, mana tips).
Leveling: a quick 1-30 route at the top.
Job advancement: the answer first, with every class's NPC and town in one list.

entries.title: New character stats
items: Builds: a new "New character? Your first 9 points" section with the starting stat spread for every class, what to do with your points until level 10, and your Beginner skill points.
Home: "Your run" now shows your starting stats when you're under level 10.

entries.title: Grand Launch patch notes
items: News: the Grand Launch (v1.0.0) notes, plus new cards for the Excavation Site and Stumpy, and the GM events.
Events: real end dates (Nov 18), everything The Journey Begins gives you, how the closed-test rings arrive, and Halloween's Oct 27 (5 PM PDT) start with the Pumpkin Basket reward.
KPQ now shows Channels 3-12 everywhere.
Citizenship: you buy your house from Bianca or Scarlett, and it's one home per account.
Home: a new deadline for the Nov 18 event finish.

entries.title: Launch week: citizenship, events, Free Market and Lv 60+
items: New Citizenship & Housing page: Henesys or Kerning, all 10 grades with a grade planner, daily greetings, every donation item, the story quests and how to get a house.
New Events page: a step-by-step Mark of the Beta walkthrough, a 14-gift tracker for The Journey Begins, and Malady's Halloween (Oct 28).
New Free Market page: shops and store permits, pricing at the sold price, what sells, scams to dodge, bots and bans.
Leveling: a new Level 60 and beyond section with the best maps past 55 and a hit-chance checker for your ACC.
Home: a deadline bar with countdowns, led by the Founder's Package claim deadline (Nov 30).

entries.title: Fact-check pass after Founder's Access
items: New News page: launch-day info, events (The Journey Begins, Mark of the Beta, Halloween, Moon Bunny, Dec 9 guilds), deadlines and every patch since Oct 6.
Fixed: AoE skills like Slash Blast, Rush, Iron Arrow, Arrow Bomb, Poison Breath and Thunder Bolt hit 6 monsters, not 4. Holy Arrow is single-target.
Fixed: weapon attack scrolls are Greater +4 and Chaos +5 at launch. The scroll simulator now has weapon, magic and stat scroll types.
Fixed: Super Megaphone is 1,500 NX, and megaphones need Lv 15 from Oct 21. Party EXP needs activity every 10 seconds, not 15.
Updated class notes for the Oct 8 and Oct 15 patches (Heal range, Steal must hit, Rush no longer moves bosses, Bless), plus KPQ answers 21 and 30 and current Free Market prices.

entries.title: Bosses, KPQ, quests and mesos
items: New Bosses page: all 7 bosses with sprites, drops, when you're ready to fight them, and a respawn timer you can start on your phone.
New KPQ guide: Cloto's coupon answers and every rope, kitten and barrel combo, with a tracker to cross them off.
New Quest guide: the quests worth doing at every level, what they're worth in levels, rewards, and a checklist.
New Money making guide: launch-week Free Market prices, the best meso quests, boss meso drops and crafting profit.

entries.title: Crafting guide
items: New Crafting page: what to keep for each of the six professions, with item icons and the monsters that drop each material.
"Never sell these" list, crafting level requirements and how Screws, ingots, cloth and leather are made.

entries.title: Tools, feedback and a sprinkle of whimsy
items: New Tools page: EXP calculator (how long until your next level, with a stopwatch to measure your EXP per hour) and a scroll simulator.
Every page now asks "Was this right?" Tell us what you saw in game and we'll fix it.
New tier list: the best class for solo grinding, bossing, party play and new players.
Return Scroll button, copy-link buttons, shareable "Your run" links and a LEVEL UP! at levels 10, 30, 70 and 100.
Phone tab bar gets a Tiers tab; dropdowns and buttons now match across the site.

entries.title: The guide goes live
items: Builds for all 10 jobs, the 1 to 100 leveling route, job advancement, secrets and Classic rules.
"Your run": pick your class, job and level and get your grind spot, AP and SP.
Site-wide search (press / on desktop).
